$NVDAB slipped to 148.7 USDT, down 4.85% from the session high of 157.22 USDT. Volume sat near 39 million USDT, so the pullback was well-filled even though the market was asleep.

$BTC slid to $59,979.61, down 1.739% in 24h. It peaked at $64,603.12 but couldn't hold, finding a floor near $59,574.43. Volume sat around 28.7k with $1.78 B traded.

$BTC's up 3.05% to 61,121.61, hit a high of 61,959.93 and slid to a low of 58,768.51. Volume pushed past 21 k coins, quote volume over $1.27 B.

Nothing wild happened; just a calm day for these three.

$BNB nudged up to $558.99, +1.9 % after testing $560.57 and finding support near $537. Volume sat around 90k BNB, pushing $49.6 M of quote flow.

Watch the $BTC order-book depth as price hovers between the $60.5K-$61.5K corridor; any shift there could set the tone for the next session.

Meanwhile $XRP slipped 1.2% to $0.9208, hovering $0.9118-$0.9389 and pulling $80.05 M in volume. Leaders are pushing higher, laggard's just drifting down. Looks like a quiet swing today.

$ETH is up 1.01% against $BTC, so it's nudging ahead of Bitcoin in the pair. Meanwhile $BTC rose 4.724% in the last 24 h, but the 20-coin basket averaged 5.223%, meaning the alt slice is beating Bitcoin overall. ETH's little edge on BTC contrasts with the broader alt outperformance. Nothing wild, just a modest shift in relative strength.

Leaders grabbed the upside, laggards got knocked down; market's pulling ahead for the big-cap pair and the DeFi token, but the meme coin's losing steam.

$SOXLBUSDT slipped about 2.3% to $32.72, its 24-hour swing was roughly 18%, a bit tighter than the usual 22% range, about a third less volatile than normal.

$HYPEUSDT barely budged, down 0.6% to $60.98, and its daily range stayed right on its typical 9.8% level, essentially unchanged.

$NVDABUSDT fell 3.7% to $130.58, with a 9.1% swing versus an 8.7% average, that's basically spot on its normal volatility.

All three moved within expected bounds; nothing wild on the board.

$BTC's at $55,962, down 9.07% in 24h. It peaked near $62,342, but the low was $55,555, so today's price is barely above the day's floor. Volume hit ~47.5k, quote volume around $2.81 B.

$PAXG barely held up, down 2.33% to $3,538.79 with 38.4 M USDT traded. Meanwhile $SOXL crashed 25.44% to $33.55 on a whopping 149.6 M USDT volume.
